# jurisdiction polity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:jurisdictionPolity`](gmeow-jurisdictionPolity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/jurisdictionPolity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The governing polity (state, administrative body, or organization) that held jurisdiction over the place during this tenure. Functional: a single tenure has exactly one governing polity.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:jurisdictionPolity`](gmeow-jurisdictionPolity.md) from [`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single governing polity (state, administrative body, organization) of a jurisdiction tenure; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid multiple polities on one tenure — competing sovereignty is multiple standpoint-indexed tenures ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:jurisdictionPolity`](gmeow-jurisdictionPolity.md) per [`JurisdictionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) (an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)).

### Examples

- ex:jt [`gmeow:jurisdictionPolity`](gmeow-jurisdictionPolity.md) ex:stateA.
